objective: Restyle the reviewed V5 deck as a concise visual dictionary using the approved Julia layout examples, without recalculating or replacing the aggregate evidence.

visual_rules.structure: Short title and subtitle, definition/population strip, chart-first body, compact source line.
visual_rules.distribution: Blue bars; standard distribution labels rounded to whole percentages; counts remain integers.
visual_rules.attrition: Rates retain one decimal and use relative high/mid/low pills within each chart panel.
visual_rules.dense_panels: The first 14 rows are shown when a standard bar panel is denser; all source rows remain in the HTML and V5 remains the detailed reference.
visual_rules.complex_charts: Original V5 chart types and payloads are retained inside the simplified card system.
